*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2026 H5N1 outbreak]]
**[[Scotland]]'s [[NatureScot]] denies a 2026 licence for hunting [[northern gannet]]s on [[Sula Sgeir]], citing possible harm to the local gannet population after recent [[bird-flu]] deaths. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260804-last-scottish-island-bird-hunt-banned-after-almost-500-years (AFP via RFI)]

**[[Italy]] experiences its fourth [[heatwave]] of the summer with the [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|health ministry]] issuing [[extreme heat warning|red alerts]] for a record 25 cities. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/italy-s-4th-heat-wave-peaks-with-red-alerts-in-record-25-cities/4016831 (AA)]
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
